cultures.name: Roman
cultures.description: Disciplined city-builders of Italy. Full building trees, legionary infantry, and the burden of Senate politics.

cultures.name: Hellenic
cultures.description: Heirs of Alexander and the free poleis. Superb phalanx infantry, great cities, strong trade and learning.

cultures.name: Eastern
cultures.description: Kingdoms of the Iranian plateau and Anatolia. Horse archers, armored cataphracts, and vast open country.

cultures.name: Punic
cultures.description: Maritime merchant empire of the western sea. Wealthy ports, hired armies, and elite citizen bands.

cultures.name: Nile
cultures.description: The old riches of the Nile under new dynasts. Unmatched farmland and dense, wealthy cities.

cultures.name: Tribal
cultures.description: The proud peoples beyond the olive line. Cheap, fierce warbands and swollen towns, but no taste for marble: settlement growth is capped below the great-city tiers.

cultures.name: Independent
cultures.description: Free towns, brigands, and peoples owing allegiance to no great power.
